targeted_corrections.prompt: Edit target: the supplied generated Drake Bay beach image. Make ONE precise correction only: completely remove the tiny two lines of spurious white lettering in the extreme bottom-right corner of the sand, replacing those letters seamlessly with matching natural sand texture. prompts.name: arenal
prompts.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Produce a photographic retake of the attached travel references for a premium Costa Rica tour cover. This must read as a real full-frame travel photograph, with the vivid but believable color separation, warm sunlight, clear fine detail, convincing foliage and optical depth seen in the supplied Traslados Panama style references. Preserve photographic irregularity and true surface texture. Avoid the smooth painterly AI look, waxy leaves, repeated vegetation patterns, fake mist, orange color wash, teal-and-orange grading, excessive HDR and perfect symmetrical compositions. Restrained warm highlights, natural clean blue water or sky, varied authentic green foliage, realistic shadows. No typography, watermarks, logos, borders, collage, vignette or baked-in website gradient. Horizontal 3:2 photograph at high detail, roughly 1536x1024. Place the main recognisable feature in the central upper half so a narrow vertical card crop still works, while the complete landscape works as a wide banner. Image 1 is the geographic reference to preserve: the actual rough, slightly asymmetric Arenal Volcano silhouette and its steep grey upper slopes and patchy green lower slopes near La Fortuna, Costa Rica. Image 2 is ONLY the style/color/detail reference, do not copy its monkey, lake or Panama location. Retake the Arenal view as a beautiful natural travel photograph: volcano rising beyond mixed tropical woodland and a little sunlit grassland, normal clear late-morning light, a few small uneven clouds in a pale blue sky, 35mm lens at f/8, fine stone and individual leaf texture with realistic distant softness. Keep the volcano prominent but believable, no lava, no eruption, no snow, no beach and no artificial turquoise lake.
